name: atlas_search_graph
description: Search the published graph across startups, partners and providers. Follow nextCursor with the same query to page through a snapshot; restart if it changes. Reports the published and current repository revisions.

name: atlas_get_startup
description: Read a startup, its sourced connections, funding events and news from the published graph.

name: atlas_get_startup_record
description: Read the complete authoritative startup source record by canonical ID, with repository revision and record digest. This is editable repository data, not the published graph.

name: atlas_validate_startup_edit
description: Preview a canonical-ID startup metadata edit against its expected record digest. Returns the complete merged record, changes, repository revision and validation token. Checks structure and conflicts, not source truth; writes nothing.

name: atlas_propose_startup_edit
description: Propose an exactly validated startup edit as one draft PR using the existing OAuth connection. Requires repository revision, prior record digest and validation token. Returns verified proposal-head readback; never merges or publishes. Recover uncertain outcomes before retrying.

name: atlas_get_startup_edit_proposal
description: Read-only recovery for an exact startup edit intent. Verifies its deterministic branch, complete one-file diff, parent, PR and authoritative record readback. Never creates or repairs an incomplete proposal; publication remains separate.

name: atlas_validate_startup
description: Validate a source-backed startup addition or update and return its previous record and repository revision. It does not verify sources.

name: atlas_propose_startup
description: Create a draft pull request adding or updating reviewed startup metadata, founders, funding, logos, articles and sourced relationships. Requires a fresh validation revision; never merges or publishes. Inspect any uncertain write before retrying.

name: atlas_get_connection
description: Check whether the signed-in caller has connected the repository-scoped GitHub App. Returns no credentials.

name: atlas_search_partners
description: Search indexed partner leads and reviewed metadata. A name or logo does not establish a provider relationship.

name: atlas_get_partner
description: Read one exact partner lead and its reviewed metadata.

name: atlas_validate_partner
description: Validate a reviewed partner update and return the current revision and previous record. Does not verify the evidence.

name: atlas_propose_partner
description: Create a draft pull request updating one existing partner after independent source and identity review. Requires a fresh validation revision; never merges or publishes. Do not automatically retry an uncertain write.

name: atlas_search_opportunities
description: Search the current Startup Atlas repository catalogue before adding an entry.

name: atlas_get_opportunity
description: Read an opportunity and provenance from the current repository.

name: atlas_validate_opportunity
description: Validate a proposed source-backed entry and duplicates without writing. Returns the main commit revision. It does not fetch or verify programme terms.

evidence.description: Public, source-backed evidence for this entry, including geographic eligibility and material restrictions. Do not include private application details.

name: atlas_add_opportunity
description: Create an idempotent data branch and draft pull request in castlemilk/startup-atlas using the caller’s OAuth connection. Requires the revision returned by validation. It never merges, deploys, edits existing entries or modifies code. Only use when the user requested adding this public, source-backed entry.

evidence.description: Public, source-backed evidence for this entry, including geographic eligibility and material restrictions. Do not include private application details.
